subject.title: [Bug]: Write/exec tool parameters silently dropped after long conversations (content/command missing)

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96115 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96127 are resolved, is that Tool Search subset sufficient to close this broad issue, or should this issue stay open for separate long-session provider/streaming proof?
rationale: Current source proof covers compact Tool Search argument forwarding, while this issue and recent comments also describe mid-session argument loss with nested args and provider/streaming pressure that the open PR does not prove fixed.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Keep this issue open until a live long-session provider/streaming reproduction is either fixed or confidently ruled out after the Tool Search subset lands.

options.title: Split remaining scope
options.body: After the Tool Search PR lands, open or designate a narrower follow-up for provider/streaming long-session argument loss and close this issue with that canonical link.

options.title: Close after Tool Search fix
options.body: Close this issue after the Tool Search subset lands only if maintainers intentionally define the remaining reports as covered or not actionable.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a live long-session provider/streaming reproduction is either fixed or confidently ruled out after the Tool Search subset lands.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest Tool Search feature-history signal for the parser and dispatch surface that currently has source proof.
